Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary via molregno to compound_records; compound_records via doc_id to docs; molecule_dictionary via molregno to compound_structures. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
